sections.content: Use reporting verbs such as preguntó, quiso saber and explicó to report information from an interview. Keep the indirect question after the reporting verb and use normal statement order: Preguntó dónde trabajó. Quiso saber qué pasó. This lets you recount both the questions and the answers.

items.english: She wanted to know what happened.
He explained how the craft began.

sections.content: In an indirect question, keep normal statement word order: Preguntó qué pasó, not a direct-question structure.
